domain: Echelon 3 Core Infrastructure and Ecology / Assets/_Project/Scripts/World / DestructibleOrganicManager.cs

fixedFindings.problem: ProcessYieldBatchIfNeeded used IsDropOutputEmpty before acquiring the yield/drop Vault lock set. That read drop output budget from Vault-backed state without a compaction pin and could allow yield processing to reset/overwrite undrained drop output if the pre-lock read was stale.
fixedFindings.fix: Removed the pre-lock IsDropOutputEmpty route. ProcessYieldBatchIfNeeded now locks the yield/drop buffers first, checks ResolveDropOutputCount under that lock, returns fail-closed when output is non-empty, and only resets the drop budget after proving the output is empty.

fixedFindings.problem: The Loop32 helper TryReadDropOutputState acquired Vault locks while using a read-accessor name. Global Systems Doctrine requires Get/TryGet/Resolve/Read/TryRead-style accessors to stay pure and not hide lock/global-state behavior.
fixedFindings.fix: Renamed the helper to TrySnapshotDropOutputStateWithLock and updated the only call site. The name now exposes lock behavior and no TryReadDropOutputState symbol remains.
